description: Playbook for designing SaaS and startup products that convert, retain, and monetize — landing pages & CRO, checkout & forms, onboarding/activation, churn reduction, pricing psychology, dashboards, behavioral-science tactics, feature discipline, positioning/ICP, go-to-market, and AI-era differentiation.
